method: r2 -e asm.bits=16 -qc 'aaa; aflj' IOSlaveProcessor.kext.bin, union of [addr, addr+size) ranges (half-open) to avoid double-counting overlaps
note: r2's automatic detection works much better on this binary than on AppleARM7M.kext.bin -- straightforward OSMetaClass boilerplate, no hand tracing needed. This list INCLUDES the ranges this directory's module_init.yaml fiche reviewed (the init loop and six ctor calls) plus four ranges (0x80399848, 0x803998c0, 0x803998d8, 0x80399900) that fiche explicitly lists as seen-but-not-individually-read -- unlike AppleARM7M, tool and human coverage overlap here, so summing them naively would double-count.
